status_flag_bindings.status_semantics: clean_false requires a positive reference observation that the symbol is an active listing at as_of; reference active=false OR absence from the active-listing reference at as_of -> delisted (True); no reference observation -> unknown.
status_flag_bindings.derivation_evidence_rule: a same-session grouped-daily trade is NOT sufficient evidence of listing status; the active-listing reference is the authoritative source for delisting.

status_flag_bindings.status_semantics: True if the symbol appears in the exchange trading-halt feed effective at the decision PIT (prior settled session); clean_false requires the halt feed to have been observed and the symbol absent; feed unavailable -> unknown. Intraday halts that resolved before the PIT are not a standing disqualifier.
status_flag_bindings.derivation_evidence_rule: absence from price/volume data is NOT evidence of a halt; only the halt feed sets the flag.

status_flag_bindings.status_semantics: True if the reference primary exchange/market is an OTC venue; clean_false requires a positive reference observation that the primary exchange is an authorized NYSE/NASDAQ venue (the §3.1 exchange whitelist); no reference observation -> unknown. This binds the explicit otc flag to the same reference exchange field the whitelist already screens.
status_flag_bindings.derivation_evidence_rule: the exchange whitelist already rejects non-NYSE/NASDAQ; this flag records the explicit OTC determination with its reference provenance, never a hardwired False.

status_flag_bindings.status_semantics: bankrupt_8k_found (True/reject) if an SEC 8-K Item 1.03 (Bankruptcy or Receivership) is found for the issuer within the lookback window; screened_no_filing (best-effort clean_false) if the 8-K search ran over the lookback window and found none; unscreened if the search did not run. There is NO positive proof of non-bankruptcy, so clean_false is a BEST-EFFORT negative, never an assumption.
status_flag_bindings.derivation_evidence_rule: absence of an 8-K is recorded as screened_no_filing (best-effort), NOT proof of solvency; the run records bankruptcy_screen_coverage and flags any unscreened universe explicitly.

decision_gates.required_resolution: A user-approved status-source access packet must define the symbols/universe, per-flag source endpoint families, call budget, fair-access behavior, gitignored raw-payload storage, and no-secret summary policy before any live status-source call.

A later reviewed slice must implement the offline status parser + the cheap_eligible per-flag-with-provenance integration + R2 per-row lineage against fixtures, with no-silent-default behavior, before any code consumes a live payload.

DataHub / runner / production consumption remains blocked until the status sources, parser, gate integration, lineage, coverage, and production-readiness boundaries are resolved or explicitly accepted.

limitations: This artifact performs no status-source calls, reads no raw payloads, parses nothing, generates no fixtures, and implements no parser or gate integration.

It freezes the schema-first per-flag status-source contract (delisted/halted/otc/bankruptcy -> authorized source + provenance + unknown policy) for batch5 only; it does not prove source availability, coverage, fair-access terms, or production readiness.

delisted/otc come from a ticker-reference dataset, halted from a public exchange halt feed, bankruptcy best-effort from SEC 8-K Item 1.03; bankruptcy clean_false is a best-effort negative, never proof of solvency.

It does not resolve SR-PROVIDER-001; the live status fetch, parser, gate integration, lineage, DataHub/runner consumption, production storage, live_normalized evidence, and ship-gate claims remain blocked pending separate reviewed packets.
